about: Portuguese (Brazil) for the OpenDots web page. focus.js swaps each visible text of the page that matches a key, whole, for its value: text in elements, placeholders and tooltips, never what people wrote. {name} marks a part that varies and comes back in the value. tests/test_page_translations.py checks this file; tools/page_strings.cjs lists the page's texts that are not here yet.
